en: A sepia-toned illustrated postcard depicting a winding street lined with multi-story historical buildings featuring arches, balconies, and shutters. The lower left corner shows some shop signs and an awning, while the buildings on the right display arched walkways. The street scene is tranquil and unpopulated, capturing the architectural style of an old European city.
